snippet.title: New Heights: Realistic Climbing and Bouldering - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
We can finally say that New Heights is fully out now on Steam! 

It comes with a gigantic update that has cost us 19 months to develop. This update reworks the climbing system completely, optimizes a lot, includes rope based belaying and the legendary location of the Hanshelleren Cave in Flatanger, Norway. Now you can climb some of the world's most famous (and difficult) routes like Silence, B.I.G. and Change.

We are very excited to have reached this moment. This of course doesn't mean that we will stop updating the game. We are always looking to add new locations and improve the climbing system.

If you haven't already please check it out:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2179440/New_Heights_Realistic_Climbing_and_Bouldering/

New Heights is the ultimate realistic climbing and bouldering game where you get to test your skills across more than 280 routes in real crags. Try it out on the boulders of Fontainebleau or if you think you can do it on Silence in Hanshelleren Cave!

Thanks everyone for supporting us during the Early Access phase of New Heights. We are very proud of what we have been able to accomplish and wouldn't have been able to do so without our community.
